title: pytest و factory_boy
lead: pytest و factory_boy استاندارد پروژه‌های حرفه‌ای هستند. تست‌ها خواناتر، سریع‌تر و قابل نگهداری‌تر.

blocks.code:
pip install pytest pytest-django pytest-cov factory_boy faker
pip freeze | grep pytest >> requirements-dev.txt

[pytest]
DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE = library_api.settings
python_files = test_*.py tests.py
addopts =
    --reuse-db
    --cov=.
    --cov-report=term-missing
    --cov-report=html
    -ra
    -q
markers =
    slow: tests that take too long
    integration: integration tests

blocks.text: factory_boy برای ساخت داده تست به‌شکل معنادار و قابل نگهداری.

blocks.code:
import factory
from factory.django import DjangoModelFactory
from faker import Faker
from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from catalog.models import Author, Book

User = get_user_model()
fake = Faker("fa_IR")


class UserFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = User
        django_get_or_create = ("username",)

    username = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"user{n}")
    email = factory.LazyAttribute(lambda o: f"{o.username}@example.com")
    password = factory.PostGenerationMethodCall("set_password", "pass12345")


class AdminFactory(UserFactory):
    is_staff = True
    is_superuser = True


class AuthorFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Author

    full_name = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.name())
    bio = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.text(max_nb_chars=200))


class BookFactory(DjangoModelFactory):
    class Meta:
        model = Book

    title = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.sentence(nb_words=4))
    author = factory.SubFactory(AuthorFactory)
    isbn = factory.Sequence(lambda n: f"978{n:010d}")
    price = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.pydecimal(left_digits=2, right_digits=2, positive=True))
    published_at = factory.LazyFunction(lambda: fake.date_between(start_date="-10y"))
    is_active = True

import pytest
from rest_framework import status
from .factories import BookFactory, AdminFactory


@pytest.mark.django_db
class TestBookAPI:
    url = "/api/books/"

    def test_list_public(self, api_client):
        BookFactory.create_batch(3)
        response = api_client.get(self.url)
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK
        assert response.data["count"] == 3

    def test_create_requires_auth(self, api_client):
        response = api_client.post(self.url, {"title": "X"})
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED

    def test_admin_can_create(self, authenticated_admin_client):
        payload = {
            "title": "New Book",
            "author": "Author",
            "isbn": "9780000000001",
            "price": "10.00",
            "published_at": "2020-01-01",
        }
        response = authenticated_admin_client.post(self.url, payload)
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_201_CREATED

    def test_detail_not_found(self, api_client):
        response = api_client.get(f"{self.url}9999/")
        assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
